title: Shekhar Suman recalls National Awards ‘huge disaster’ with Jaya and Amitabh Bachchan

title: Bobby on being typecast as a villain after Aashram and Animal
description: Bobby Deol says he's actively trying to avoid being typecast as a villain after Aashram and Animal's success. While enjoying antagonist roles for their varied shades, he seeks diverse characters, citing Bandar as an example. He's also set to feature in upcoming web series.

title: Priyanka Chopra stuns in a black maxi dress worth Rs 14 lakh at 'The Cycle Of Love' premiere in New York
description: Priyanka Chopra Jonas turned heads at the New York premiere of 'The Cycle of Love' in an elegant black maxi dress worth a hefty price tag of Rs 14 lakhs. Discover all the details behind her chic ensemble, accessory choices, muted glam, and her executive producer role for the acclaimed documentary.

title: RJ Balaji calls 'Karuppu' ‘a fairytale journey, a generational blockbuster'
description: Suriya's latest film 'Karuppu' has made waves by running successfully for 100 days in theaters. The film has crossed an impressive Rs 300 crore in global box office earnings, marking a personal best for the actor. RJ Balaji praised the film as a generational blockbuster, and the team thanked fans for their overwhelming support. This adds further momentum to Suriya's recent successes at the box office.

title: Shaan On Arijit Exit: Singer says he hasn’t really quit
description: Shaan revealed he once considered quitting playback singing, like Arijit Singh recently did. He recalled contemplating this at 33-34, despite winning awards, and shared advice from Sonu Nigam and KK to "keep his standard." Shaan also noted Arijit's exit may not be final. He's now reunited with Saif Ali Khan for "Haiwaan."

title: Quote of the day by Anthony Hopkins
description: Sir Anthony Hopkins emphasizes the importance of self-acceptance and the necessity to release past regrets. He encourages individuals to recognize their imperfections and to push forward in life. After a challenging early life battling dyslexia and bullying, he turned to the arts, ultimately receiving acclaim for his remarkable performances, notably in 'The Silence of the Lambs'. Hopkins advocates for embracing one’s authentic self rather than an unattainable ideal.

title: Quote of the day by Aishwarya Rai
description: Aishwarya Rai Bachchan highlights the remarkable strength in opting for silence rather than engaging in public debates. She conveys that true resilience stems from profound self-respect and an inner calm. Throughout her career, which was often subjected to intense public attention, she embraced dignity by remaining composed. This strategy has been vital in preserving her mental peace while ensuring her talents continued to shine brightly.

title: 7 Dogs: Know happens to Salman and Sanjay’s characters in the climax
description: Salman Khan and Sanjay Dutt reunite in Saudi thriller '7 Dogs', which got mixed reviews. Khalid, an Interpol officer, is tasked with stopping the '7 Dogs' gang's Pink Lady drug shipment to the Middle East, aided by ex-convict Ghali. Betrayals, captures, and a last-minute lead follow. title: Aishwarya Lekshmi's parents wanted her to marry a doctor

After obtaining her medical degree, Aishwarya boldly charted her course in modeling and acting, a pivot that her parents found hard to embrace at first. Ashraf emphasized that Aishwarya symbolizes the shifting cultural norms of the new generation.

title: Four injured at Yash’s ‘Toxic’ event in Hyderabad; case filed
description: During a pre-release event for the film 'Toxic' at Malla Reddy University in Hyderabad, a sound box system unexpectedly collapsed, injuring four individuals. The incident took place while Rocking Star Yash was engaging with his fans on Saturday night. Authorities have initiated a case against both the event management team and the university's administration. The movie is set to premiere worldwide on August 26.

title: Hayden Panettiere’s mom says she did not force her daughter to do anything
description: Lesley Vogel, mother of actress Hayden Panettiere, has firmly rejected claims of pressuring her daughter into acting. She emphasized that, although she was a strong presence in Hayden's life, she never resorted to abusive practices. Vogel highlighted that the early days of her daughter's career were primarily aimed at funding her college education. Meanwhile, Hayden has openly discussed the stress and demands she faced as a child in the industry.

title: In 1975, why was ' Sholay' declared a flop?
description: Despite being a box office triumph, Bollywood classic Sholay was initially labeled a flop, drawing concern from newspapers about its hefty budget's impact on the film industry.
